_readme: The thirteen PostHog alerts that replace sixteen of the twenty-six live Datadog monitors.
The other ten go to the liveness sweep (8) and the daily digests (2) — the complete
twenty-six-row disposition, with every retired threshold, is README.md §"Monitor
Alerts are PRODUCTION ONLY (project 354071). apply.sh will refuse to create them in the
non-production project: a preview deploy failing a cron is not an incident, and the same
alert firing from two projects trains the operator to ignore it.
The `insight` field names an entry in insights.json by NAME, not id — ids differ per
project and are resolved at apply time.
`replaces.datadogQuery` is the retired Datadog query verbatim. It is here so that
re-promoting a threshold, or auditing whether the port changed the meaning, is a diff
rather than archaeology. Do not delete it when observability/datadog/ is removed at
AECI-651 — this becomes the only record.

alerts.name: AECi — Cron job failed (any daily/hourly job)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Cron job failed (any of the thirteen, 24 h)

replaces.datadogMonitor: AECi — Algolia sync failed / Home stats compute failed / Data quality job failed / Retention prune failed (4 monitors)

alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — the per-job runbook named by `failing_jobs`; /admin/system shows the matching job_runs row.

alerts.name: AECi — Data quality check found ERROR-severity issues
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Data quality ERROR-severity findings (24 h)

replaces.datadogMonitor: AECi — Data quality check found ERROR-severity issues (by check)

alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Data quality check'. Report-only: humans triage, nothing auto-remediates.

alerts.name: AECi — Retention prune runaway (> 5,000 rows/table/day)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Retention prune deleted an unexpected number of rows (24 h)

replaces.datadogMonitor: AECi — Retention prune deleted an unexpected number of rows

alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Retention prune'. §7.4: a runaway must be visible HERE before it is visible as missing data.

alerts.name: AECi — Linear reconciliation: persistent stuck requests
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Linear reconciliation persistent failures (1 h)

replaces.datadogMonitor: AECi — Linear reconciliation: persistent stuck requests

alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Linear reconciliation'. §6.2 admin alert email is the parallel channel.

alerts.name: AECi — Algolia orphan sweep capped
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Algolia orphan sweep hit its safety cap (24 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Algolia index drift / orphan sweep'. Either raise DEFAULT_SAFETY_CAP deliberately or find out why the index diverged that far.

alerts.name: AECi — Auth sign-in error rate > 30% (1 h)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Auth sign-in failure rate (1 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Auth sign-in error rate'. Check the `reason` breakdown on the Auth board: link_invalid / missing_code / auth_not_configured point at three different causes.

alerts.name: AECi — Toxicity scoring outage (> 50% errors, 1 h)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Toxicity scoring failure rate (1 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Toxicity scoring outage'. Reviews still submit; they queue for human moderation without a score.

alerts.name: AECi — page_views write error rate > 10% (1 h)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — page_views write failure rate (1 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'page_views write errors'. Traffic keeps serving; the admin panel's traffic screen under-reports.

alerts.name: AECi — Linear pipeline failure rate > 50% (1 h)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Linear pipeline failure rate (1 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Linear pipeline failure'. The every-15-minute reconciliation sweep is the backstop; this alert says the backstop is doing all the work.

alerts.name: AECi — Linear webhook HMAC failures > 3 (1 h)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Linear webhook HMAC failures (1 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Linear webhook HMAC failures'. Check LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET first; if it is current, this is unauthenticated traffic.

alerts.name: AECi — WAF rate-limit / challenge spike (> 2,000 / 1 h)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — WAF rate-limit / challenge volume (1 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/waf-rate-limits.md for the rule expressions; docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'WAF rate-limit spike'.

alerts.name: AECi — p95 detail page render > 1.5 s (1 h)
alerts.insight: AECi — ALERT — Detail page render p95, cache MISS (1 h)
alerts.runbook: docs/RUNBOOKS.md — 'Detail page render slow'. Check the render-latency-distribution widget on the Traffic board first: it needs no reconstruction and cannot be wrong.
